title: A later healthy report erases an earlier canary failure
reproduction: Plan a 15-objective population (3-member cohort). Report False for one member, then True for all three. Also permute all four reports.
actual: PASSED when the later True overwrites False; permutations produce both FAILED and PASSED.
expected: Any observed failure for the same revision/cohort remains FAILED, independent of arrival order.
scope_limit: Pure evaluator only. No application activation bypass demonstrated.

title: Empty, fabricated and foreign-labelled evidence strings are not checked by the canary helper
reproduction: Supply healthy=True for every cohort member with an empty ref, an arbitrary nonexistent ref, or a ref labelled as another revision.
actual: PASSED for all three input variants. No evidence resolver or revision-bearing receipt participates in the helper call.
expected: No activation eligibility may be derived from unattested/foreign evidence; the canonical caller must prove attestation or the helper must refuse unverified input.
proposed_patch: proposals/README.md: canonical attestation and actual activation boundary
scope_limit: This is NOT a forged valid signed receipt, NOT cryptographic forgery, and NOT a proved production exploit. The foreign-revision case uses a labelled string because no revision-bound receipt exists in this value object.

title: Non-boolean health values are accepted as a passing canary
reproduction: Set every health value to 0, 1, "false" or "true".
actual: All four variants produce PASSED: they are neither identity-False nor None.
expected: Accept only exact bool or None; reject malformed health rather than treating it as success.
scope_limit: Caller input validation was not demonstrated end-to-end.

title: An explicit Split bypasses independent-sample and holdout constraints
reproduction: Use one independently verified CSV task; repeat its ID 15 times in measured and 5 times in holdout. Also test overlapping lanes, duplicate input tasks with an explicit split and omitted tasks.
actual: facts.tasks=1; measured.total=15; holdout.total=5; authorized=True. Overlapping lanes also authorize. Duplicate input rows and an incomplete partition are accepted.
expected: Validate unique task IDs and a unique/disjoint complete partition BEFORE running tasks; repeated identifiers cannot count as independent samples.
scope_limit: Actual local baseline/candidate CSV outputs are checked by an independent oracle. No real model, deployed skill or retention report is claimed. Omitted-task rejection treats Split as a partition of its declared set; the one-task inflation and overlap do not depend on that interpretation.

title: The current baseline version is not bound to the measured baseline
reproduction: Measure baseline split-v1 against csv-v2, then request promotion with candidate.current_version="different-live-baseline".
actual: authorized=True; candidate_version and applicability checks do not compare current_version to measurement.baseline_version.
expected: Refuse a measurement taken against a different current baseline, without consuming evidence.
scope_limit: Helper eligibility only; no production deployment was performed.

title: Outcome accepts positive and negative infinity despite its finite-score contract
reproduction: Construct Outcome("csv-00", True, float("inf")) and the negative-infinity variant.
actual: Both construct successfully; NaN is rejected (positive control).
expected: Reject all non-finite scores with PromotionError at the input boundary.
scope_limit: This alone is not demonstrated authorization bypass; later JSON hashing with allow_nan=False can still refuse an infinite score.
